# 2 Baruch Chapter 84 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**84:1** "And-now-therefore, hear-me, O-Israel, and-you-who-dwell-in-Babylon, give-ear-to-me."

**84:2** "For-I-will-tell-you the-interpretation-of-all-the-things-which-have-happened-to-you from-the-beginning; for-it-is-not-hidden from-me."

**84:3** "That-which-has-happened-to-you was-not-unexpected; for-it-was-decreed from-the-beginning; and-it-was-written-in-the-books-of-God."

**84:4** "Now-hear-me; for-after-the-judgment-of-your-enemies-will-come-deliverance; and-after-the-time-of-the-tribulation-will-come-consolation."

**84:5** "For-the-LORD will-repay-to-you everything-which-is-done-to-you; and-he-will-console-those-who-grieve for-Zion."

**84:6** "And-now, O-Israel, take-note-of-your-steps; and-remove-not-the-way-of-your-fathers; for-the-covenant-which-was-made with-your-fathers was-not-made for-ever."

**84:7** "But-it-was-renewed for-you by-the-Mighty-One; and-it-will-be-renewed-for-your-children-also."

**84:8** "And-he-has-promised-you that-you-will-not-be-forsaken in-your-lifetime, nor-will-your-children-be-forsaken after-you."

**84:9** "And-if-you-obey the-commandments of-the-law, the-Mighty-One will-protect-you; and-if-you-walk-in-the-ways-of-the-Most-High, he-will-not-forsake-you."

**84:10** "And-now-behold, you-are-in-captivity, and-you-are-in-a-strange-land; and-I-Baruch am-weeping-for-you from-afar."

**84:11** "Yet-I-know that-you-will-return-to-your-land; and-there-will-no-more-be-any-such-time-of-misfortune-for-you; and-you-will-dwell-in-peace in-your-holy-land, and-you-will-be-at-rest."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
